page: Microsoft Azure DC4eds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the DCEDV6 server family. Powered by dedicated Intel processors, this instance provides 4 virtual CPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server does not include integrated graphics processing units, meaning GPU-accelerated tasks are not supported.

Storage capabilities for the DC4eds_v6 include a 236 GB local disk, and the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-speed external storage volumes. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and local storage capacity provide a balanced resource density for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without resource sharing. Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and local disk availability, this server configuration is suitable for general-purpose workloads, database hosting, and application servers that benefit from dedicated processing threads and local scratch space.
